commit.message:
feat(wcs): anchor the WCS on a picked circle's centre; tidy the WCS page

A shared pick primitive, app::pick::circle (circle_centre /
circle_of_edge / circle_of_run): an edge pick resolves to its run and,
when every vertex lies on one planar circle within the feature graph's
arc tolerance, returns centre, axis and radius; a straight edge, a run
too short to call round, a non-circular curve, a face or a vertex is
refused by name (CircleRefusal), never guessed.

SetWcsAtCircleCentre wraps SetWcsOrigin at that centre (one undo step,
undo restores the previous origin) and the MCP tool
set_wcs_circle_centre runs it. The WCS page gains "Circle centre" under
Anchor on (pick a circular edge; the page states the circle), and is
laid out in three sections: a label | field grid, quarter turns as equal
buttons filling the pane, and the anchor points as a centred 3x3 compass
of equal cells.

The page moved out of pages.rs (egui_app/wcs_page.rs) and the SetWcs
dispatch arm out of state.rs (state_wcs.rs), so no file past 400 lines
grew.

Fixes #739
